title: finding(core,app-shell,i18n): console strings PR objectui#10953 left English under zh-CN — the runner's other fallbacks, the other system/* breadcrumb segments, the Build Doctor drawer body, and 'manifest ID' in every pack
body:
Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat #1 (`session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`) at the landing of PR objectui#10953 (`328abeb55`, `Fixes #10900`). The findings come from that PR's dev report and were confirmed true by its contract review `5868740252`. ⛔ Not graded or routed here; that is triage's.

## What objectui#10900 fixed, and why these were left

objectui#10900 named four surfaces from the 2026-09-28 cloud E2E, and PR objectui#10953 localized exactly those. The strings below sit beside them and still render English under zh-CN. They were outside the card's table, so the PR did not widen to them.

## Sites (measured on the PR's head `7c740d369`)

1. **The action runner's other English fallbacks**, in `packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`:
   - `'Action failed'` (twice), the error toast for a non-string error;
   - `'One or more parallel actions failed'`.

   The seam already exists: `ActionRunner.setTranslator`, which PR objectui#10953 added and which `ActionProvider` and `useActionRunner` install. Only the default success toast reads it today.
2. **The `Undo` label** on an undoable success toast. Its default is `undoLabel = 'Undo'` in `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/toast-helpers.ts`, wired by `useConsoleActionRuntime`.
3. **The other `system/*` breadcrumb segments.** In `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx`, the system branch still renders `humanizeSlug` of the URL segment for every system page except `marketplace`: `settings`, `apps`, `profile`, `approvals`, `ai-approvals` and `audit-log` are the console-host routes the review counted. This was read from the source, not measured through the UI.
4. **The Build Doctor drawer body** (`BuildDebugDrawer.tsx`): the description, the verdict lines and the section titles. The button, its tooltips and the drawer title were localized.
5. **`manifest ID` as customer-facing jargon in every pack.** PR objectui#10953 replaced it in zh only, as the card asked.
   - The `en` source `marketplace.searchPlaceholder` still says `Search apps by name or manifest ID…`.
   - The eight other packs translate it literally: `Manifest-ID`, `ID de manifiesto`, `ID de manifeste`, `マニフェストID`, `매니페스트 ID`, `ID манифеста`, `ID de manifesto`, `معرف المانيفست`.

   The objection objectui#10900 raised for zh applies to all of them. Changing an `en` value is a drift-gate event (`check:i18n-drift`), so it needs a deliberate call.

## Constraints a taker will meet

- `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` requires every new key in all ten packs.
- `Bundle Analysis` measured the eager closure at 3103.2 KB of a 3104.5 KB budget at PR objectui#10957's run. There is almost no headroom, so a new eager import will trip it.

Dedupe words: zh-CN English leftovers console, Action failed toast untranslated, system breadcrumb humanizeSlug, Build Doctor drawer English, manifest ID jargon locales. Not a duplicate of objectui#10862, which covers the designer preview files' chrome.
